# Sharjah STP Phase 6

> Phase 6 is an expansion of the Sharjah sewage treatment plant, the emirate's principal municipal wastewater works. The plant treats wastewater from Sharjah's residential and commercial districts, with treated effluent used for irrigation and other non-potable purposes. The phase-6 works extended treatment capacity at the existing site.

## Project Overview

- Category: Infrastructure & Utilities
- Location: Sharjah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Phase 6 of the Sharjah Sewage Treatment Plant expanded the emirate's main wastewater treatment works, adding around 37,500 cubic metres per day of capacity through a new activated sludge treatment stream, inlet works, a pumping station and a substation. The expansion was delivered by ACWa Services with Halcrow as consultant and came into operation in 2004. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the expansion.
